# David M. Quintana

> Bilingual (English/Spanish) clinical data engineer based in Denver, Colorado. Builds Python/pandas ETL pipelines and HL7 v2 / FHIR R4 tools that validate clinical data and produce audit-ready records under HIPAA and ICH-GCP. B.S. Health Care Information Systems, MSU Denver (2026). Graduate student at Colorado State University Global, Graduate Certificate in Information Systems Auditing (in progress, expected late 2027).

David M. Quintana (David Matthew Quintana) is a clinical data engineer, not a physician, and is not affiliated with any medical practice of the same name.

## Clinical data work
- [Portfolio home](https://davidquintana.dev/): summary, skills, credentials, contact
- [All clinical data projects](https://davidquintana.dev/hcis-portfolio.html): problem, what was built, and result for each project
- [EVA CTMS Archive case study](https://davidquintana.dev/eva-ctms-case-study.html): 10-stage local Python ETL pipeline; 9,925 clinical-trial documents, 6,830 patient records, 18% patient-ID mismatch caught before migration; zero PHI exposure
- [Bilingual Patient Intake to FHIR R4](https://davidquintana.dev/intake-web-app.html): FastAPI + Pydantic v2 service returning a validated FHIR R4 Bundle; 80 tests, 100% coverage
- [HL7 v2 Infectious Disease Parser](https://davidquintana.dev/hl7-parser.html): parses ORU^R01 lab messages, verifies LOINC codes, reports defects by HL7 location; 81 tests, 99% coverage
- [Pediatric CDS Dosage Calculator](https://davidquintana.dev/pediatric-cds-calculator.html): weight-based dosing with a hard stop above the maximum dose; 58 tests, 100% coverage
